description: This file defines the 'HiringManagerUserRole' class in the OrangeHRM system, responsible for managing access permissions for hiring managers regarding various recruitment-related entities such as vacancies, candidates, interviews, and their associated attachments and histories. It extends an abstract role and utilizes multiple traits to facilitate service interactions, implementing methods to retrieve accessible entity IDs based on permissions.

classes.name: HiringManagerUserRole
classes.description: A class representing the user role for hiring managers, providing methods to retrieve IDs of accessible entities such as vacancies, candidates, interviews, and their attachments and histories based on the hiring manager's permissions.

methods.name: getAccessibleIdsForEntity
methods.description: Returns list of IDs for a given entity type that the hiring manager has access to, based on required permissions.

methods.name: getAccessibleVacancyIds
methods.description: Fetches vacancy IDs accessible by the hiring manager.

methods.name: getAccessibleVacancyAttachmentIds
methods.description: Fetches vacancy attachment IDs accessible by the hiring manager.

methods.name: getAccessibleCandidateIds
methods.description: Fetches candidate IDs accessible by the hiring manager.

methods.name: getAccessibleInterviewIds
methods.description: Fetches interview IDs accessible by the hiring manager.

methods.name: getAccessibleInterviewAttachmentIds
methods.description: Fetches interview attachment IDs accessible by the hiring manager.

methods.name: getAccessibleCandidateHistoryIds
methods.description: Fetches candidate history IDs accessible by the hiring manager.

methods.name: getAccessibleCandidateActionHistoryIds
methods.description: Fetches candidate action history IDs accessible by the hiring manager.
